WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', month_start) AS metric_time__month
    , monthly_paid_buyer_count AS __monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , monthly_paid_order_count AS __monthly_paid_order_count
    , monthly_paid_sales_cents AS __monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count AS __monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."monthly_paid_summary" monthly_paid_model_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_10.monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_repeat_rate) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
  , MAX(subq_17.monthly_paid_avg_order_value) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(__monthly_paid_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_buyer_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count) AS monthly_paid_order_count
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS monthly_paid_sales_cents
    , SUM(__monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(__monthly_paid_repeat_buyer_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__monthly_paid_buyer_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_paid_repeat_rate
    , CAST(SUM(__monthly_paid_sales_cents) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__monthly_paid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS monthly_paid_avg_order_value
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__month BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
) subq_17

2026年6月青禾付费会员月报核对结果如下（全渠道、全门店；以月末符合付费资格的账户为统计范围，回看该自然月内全部有效订单）：

| 指标 | 结果 |
|---|---:|
| 购买账户数 | 3386 个CRM会员账户 |
| 有效订单数 | 5323 单 |
| 净销售额 | 90671821 分 |
| 复购账户数 | 1276 个CRM会员账户 |
| 复购率 | 约 37.68% |
| 每单净额 | 17033.97 分/单 |

口径说明：复购率＝月末付费会员复购人数÷月末付费会员购买人数；每单净额＝月末付费会员净销售额÷月末付费会员有效订单数。本结果按P1暂定口径试算；门店日期规则用于总部月报仍待书面确认。
question: 核对青禾2026年6月P1付费会员月报：用月底资格选账户，回看整月所有渠道门店的有效订单，统计购买账户数、有效单数、净销售额、复购账户数、复购人数占购买人数的比例和每单净额。金额用分，均额分/单。
